description: Structured comparison starter dataset for 70 institutions in Chhattisgarh. Null means a comparable value was not verified; it does not mean zero.
data_quality_notes: Course lists are programme-family summaries, not a complete verified branch-by-branch catalogue.
Fees, average/median packages, highest package, campus area, student feedback, student counts and highest-package recipient counts require current institution-level source verification.
Tier 1/2/3 is not a universal official classification. Use a stated ranking source such as NIRF instead.
Placement counts must use the same graduating year and distinguish eligible students, offers and unique students placed.
